xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr:
There is no immediate impact on financial, operations or other activities of the Company. The order is entirely contrary to the principles of natural justice and lacks factual authenticity, despite the relevant details being presented before the Assessing Officer.
